name: Converter
author: NucleoOS
description: Unit converter for twelve quantities: length, mass, temperature, volume, area, speed, pressure, energy, data, time, angle and fuel consumption. Type once, read every unit at the same time.

descriptions.en: Unit converter for twelve quantities: length, mass, temperature, volume, area, speed, pressure, energy, data, time, angle and fuel consumption. Type once, read every unit at the same time.
descriptions.it: Convertitore di unità per dodici grandezze: lunghezza, massa, temperatura, volume, superficie, velocità, pressione, energia, dati, tempo, angolo e consumi. Scrivi una volta, leggi tutte le unità insieme.
